what: TechnipFMC designs and builds the equipment that produces oil and gas from beneath the sea: subsea trees, manifolds, flexible pipe and the installation vessels that put them in place.
customers: Oil and gas companies developing offshore fields, especially in Brazil, West Africa, the North Sea and the Gulf of Mexico.
money: subsea production systems, flexible pipe, installation and services
wellhead and pressure control equipment for land wells
moat: An integrated model that designs, builds and installs the whole subsea system, which shortens project timelines enough that operators pay for it rather than tendering each piece.
risks: Offshore project sanctioning is lumpy and depends on oil prices
Large fixed-price projects carry execution risk
It pays only a small dividend
Debt of about $1.2 billion roughly matches cash
opportunities: Revenue grew about 9% last year and about 14% a year over three years
Return on invested capital of 24% after years of restructuring
A record backlog from deepwater projects in Brazil, Guyana and West Africa
watch: Subsea inbound orders and the backlog converted to revenue.
